name: Blessed Sight
description: Roll (X) dice. For each roll of 5+, add one wyrd dice to your saved wyrd dice. Then, this fighter makes a Wait action.

name: Stealthy
description:
Whenever an enemy fighter is targeting this fighter, this fighter is in cover if both of the following are true:
- It is more than 6” from the enemy fighter.
- It is within 1” of an obstacle, or part of its base is underneath any part of a terrain piece.

name: One with the shadows
description: If this fighter is in cover from an enemy fighter, it is not visible to that fighter.

name: Slink away
description: This fighter makes a free retreat action.

name: Murder Stab
description: Add half the value of this ability (rounding up) to the Fight characteristic of this fighter’s next melee attack action.

name: Shadowy Killers
description: Whenever this fighter is activated, if it is not visible to enemy fighters, you may add 1 to the critical hit characteristic of their next attack action.

name: Skitterleap
description: Magical ability. A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1” of an enemy fighter or when carrying a token. Remove this fighter from the battlefield, then set it up on the battlefield floor or on a platform, more than 6” from all enemy warriors, objective markers and scenario tokens.

name: Gnawdoom
description: Magical ability. Select an enemy fighter within 6” and roll (X) d6. For each roll that exceeds the target’s Defense characteristic, allocate 2 damage points to that enemy fighter.

name: Enshrouding Shadows
description: Magical ability. Until the end of the battleround, friendly fighters within (X/2)” of this fighter are not visible to other fighters.

name: Pack Tactics
description: For this fighter’s next attack action, you may add 1 to it’s Fight characteristic for each friendly Henchman within 1” of the target.

name: Sigmar's Blessing
description:
This fighter may call for one of Sigmar's Blessings by spending saved Wyrd Dice:

- **Heart of Steel:** During this fighter’s activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to automatically pass a panic test.
- **Righteous Fury:** During this fighter’s activation, after making a hit roll, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to turn a hit into a critical hit.
- **Sigmar Protects:** During an enemy fighter’s activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to perform a reaction with this fighter without needing or spending an action to do so.
